'''Beshel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a shop on the Lower [[Promenade]], where he built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials.

==Behind the scenes==
Beshel was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears as an Armormech crew skill trainer on Nar Shaddaa.
